description:
The cheapest NFTs for sale on GONDI from one collection or by one
artist, cheapest first: each with its listing price in its currency
and in USD, the marketplace it is listed on and gondi_url, the page
where the user buys it. Answers "what's the cheapest NFT from this
collection" and "what's the cheapest NFT from this artist". Pass
exactly one of collection_slug and artist_slug: when you have a name,
call search_gondi first and take the slug from its result. A
collection's list counts its wrapped versions and the vaults holding
its NFTs, as its GONDI page does; each row names the collection it is
in.

artist_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the artist to list.
artist_slug.title: Artist Slug

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection to list.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

name: list_cheapest_for_sale

MarketOrder.description:
A listing or a bid: an order someone signed and that is still open.
Its amount is its price, which is what the buyer or bidder pays.

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

buyer_fee_percent.description: The GONDI fee the listing's buyer or the bid's bidder pays, as a percent of the price its maker set; already inside buyer_pays, never on top of it. 0 on every listing and every regular bid; only a stealth bid's publication fee (STEALTH_BID_PUBLICATION) and a BuyNowPayLaterOrder's fee fall on the bidder.
buyer_fee_percent.title: Buyer Fee Percent

buyer_pays.description: What the listing's buyer or the bid's bidder pays in total, in currency_symbol: the listed price for a listing, the bid for a bid. GONDI's seller fee comes out of the seller's proceeds, not on top of this. Buying with a loan adds its own fee (get_buy_with_loan_quote).
buyer_pays.title: Buyer Pays

gondi_fee_percent.description: The SELLER's GONDI fee when the order executes, as a percent of its price, at GONDI's current rates. It comes out of the seller's proceeds and never adds to what the buyer or bidder pays (buyer_pays). It is the sale fee (SALE), a stealth order's (STEALTH_ASK, STEALTH_BID_EXECUTION) or a sell-and-repay listing's (SELL_AND_REPAY), and 0 on CryptoPunks. It is 0 for another marketplace's order: GONDI adds nothing, and that marketplace's own fee, such as OpenSea's, is inside the price and comes off the seller's proceeds. Creator royalties are not included; the order does not say which of its fees they are.
gondi_fee_percent.title: Gondi Fee Percent

maker_address.description: The seller of a listing, the bidder of a bid.
maker_address.title: Maker Address

marketplace.description: Where the order or sale lives; GONDI for GONDI's own.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

order_type.description: What the order is placed on: one NFT (SingleNFTOrder, and the SellAndRepayOrder and BuyNowPayLaterOrder listings), every NFT of the collection (CollectionOrder), those with one or several traits (TraitOrder, MultipleTraitOrder) or a chosen set of them (SetBidOrder).
order_type.title: Order Type

MarketOrder.title: MarketOrder

nfts.description: Cheapest first, by what each price is worth in ETH; empty when nothing is for sale.
nfts.title: Nfts
